planets.name: TOI-1899 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1899 with a 29.1-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-1899 b crosses its star every 29.1 days and is 0.99 times as wide as Jupiter, found in 2020.
text.introduction: TOI-1899 b transits TOI-1899 every 29.1 days and is 0.99 times as wide as Jupiter. Orbit and size follow Lin et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
